newsitem.title: GEORGIA: Georgian parliament approves new finance minister.
newsitem.headline: Georgian parliament approves new finance minister.

text.p: Georgia's parliament has approved the appointment of 26-year-old economist Mikhail Chkuaseli as the Finance Minister of the former Soviet republic.
Georgian President Eduard Shevardnadze appointed Chkuaseli to head the ministry last month, but parliamentary approval was needed for him to take the office.
Before his appointment Chkuaseli was Shevardnadze's representative in west Georgia's Guria region. Before that he headed a commercial bank.
Chkuaseli is a member of Shevardnadze's Citizen Union party which has a majority of seats in parliament.

Talking to deputies on Wednesday, Chkuaseli said he would support economic reforms in the republic, focusing on developing entrepreneurship, raising state revenues and clamping down on the shadow economy.
